scripts.build: bun run check-types && bun run test && bun --filter '@luseefor/synthex-core' build && bun --filter synthex-ui build && bun --filter '@luseefor/synthex-react-web' build && bun --filter '@luseefor/synthex-cli' build && bun --filter '@luseefor/web-preview' build
scripts.build:web-preview:ci: npm run build --workspace @luseefor/synthex-core && npm run build --workspace synthex-ui && npm run build --workspace @luseefor/synthex-react-web && npm run build --workspace @luseefor/web-preview
scripts.registry:check: node ./scripts/generate-registry.mjs && git diff --exit-code registry.json packages/web-preview/public/registry.json && node ./scripts/validate-registry.mjs
scripts.test: bun --filter synthex-ui --filter '@luseefor/synthex-react-web' --filter '@luseefor/synthex-core' --filter '@luseefor/synthex-cli' test && bun run test:scripts
